note: `caption` is what the subtitles show; `say` is the same sentence spelled for the speech model. Every claim is traced in EVIDENCE.md.

lines.caption: Payroll on Friday. Rent on the first. An invoice next week.
lines.say: Payroll on Friday. Rent on the first. An invoice next week.

lines.caption: Hodd is a treasury on Arc that keeps money ahead of what it owes.
lines.say: Hodd is a treasury on Arc that keeps money ahead of what it owes.

lines.caption: Hodd reads your wallet's live USDC on Arc Testnet, and the bills you enter.
lines.say: Hodd reads your wallet's live U S D C on Arc testnet, and the bills you enter.

lines.caption: The Treasury Engine protects every bill inside your lead time, from 3 to 30 days, plus a safety buffer.
lines.say: The treasury engine protects every bill inside your lead time, from three to thirty days, plus a safety buffer.

lines.caption: Only what is left is deployable. No language model calculates an amount.
lines.say: Only what is left is deployable. No language model calculates an amount.

lines.caption: Autopilot runs from a vault contract. The owner's wallet owns it; Hodd's Circle agent wallet is only its operator.
lines.say: Autopilot runs from a vault contract. The owner's wallet owns it. Hodd's Circle agent wallet is only its operator.

lines.caption: This owner funded Autopilot with 30 USDC from their own wallet.
lines.say: This owner funded Autopilot with thirty U S D C from their own wallet.

lines.caption: The contract allows Morpho, Hodd's USYC pool, one approved recipient capped at 7 USDC, and the owner.
lines.say: The contract allows Morpho, Hodd's U S Y C pool, one approved recipient capped at seven U S D C, and the owner.

lines.caption: Anything else reverts. The owner can pause, or take everything back without Hodd.
lines.say: Anything else reverts. The owner can pause, or take everything back without Hodd.

lines.caption: On October 15, the engine proposed: invest 10.52 USDC into Morpho, at a 4.20% recent yield.
lines.say: On October fifteenth, the engine proposed: invest ten point five two U S D C into Morpho, at a four point two percent recent yield.

lines.caption: The AI advisor, gpt-oss-120b on Groq, saw aggregate figures only, and answered FOLLOW: higher yield, no pending bills.
lines.say: The A I advisor, G P T O S S one twenty B on Grok, saw aggregate figures only, and answered: follow. Higher yield, no pending bills.

lines.caption: It may follow, allocate, wait or move between strategies. Bills never reach the model; answers outside its envelope are discarded.
lines.say: It may follow, allocate, wait, or move between strategies. Bills never reach the model, and answers outside its envelope are discarded.

lines.caption: Many runs end in no action, and the history records those too.
lines.say: Many runs end in no action, and the history records those too.

lines.caption: Before signing, the runner checks the decision against fresh balances.
lines.say: Before signing, the runner checks the decision against fresh balances.

lines.caption: The Circle agent wallet signed one call on the owner's vault: depositToStrategy.
lines.say: The Circle agent wallet signed one call on the owner's vault: deposit to strategy.

lines.caption: Arc confirmed it. Hodd verified the receipt from the vault's own events, then marked the run complete.
lines.say: Arc confirmed it. Hodd verified the receipt from the vault's own events, then marked the run complete.

lines.caption: Cash can also earn in Hodd's USYC pool, the one contract Circle allowlisted.
lines.say: Cash can also earn in Hodd's U S Y C pool, the one contract Circle allow-listed.

lines.say: A one U S D C round trip returned zero point nine nine nine nine.

lines.caption: Circle Gateway unifies USDC across 12 testnets, Arc included.
lines.say: Circle Gateway unifies U S D C across twelve testnets, Arc included.
